title: Open-source project: LiveBoard real-time collaborative task board
text: LiveBoard (https://github.com/SahulHameed-developer/liveboard) is Sahul's open-source real-time collaborative Kanban board, like Trello. It uses Node.js, Express and Socket.IO (WebSockets) for instant sync, live cursors and presence; a CRDT (last-writer-wins map with a hybrid logical clock) for conflict-free merging; optimistic UI updates; IndexedDB for offline-first storage with an outbox of pending changes; and an event-sourced, event-driven backend. In a load test it handled 1,000 concurrent WebSocket clients with 100% delivery and p95 fan-out latency of 19.5 ms. Live demo: https://sahulhameed-developer.github.io/liveboard/.
